note: 2-story house, small footprint similar to house #3 (8.50m x 10.00m). Named grid confirmed identical on S-02 (spread footing plan) and S-03 (pile footing plan). Named grid E is the topmost named row per spec convention, so rows above it take a NEGATIVE pos_m. DUMMY GRIDS: as of 2026-08-01 this master carries 11 user-supplied dummy lines -- x: 1'(-0.6), 1''(1.1), 1'''(2.3), 1''''(3.3), 2'(5.2, added 2026-08-01), 3'(9.1); y: E'(-2), E''(-1.1), A'(1.6), E'''(4.2), C'(6.6). All were given directly by the user (confidence 1) rather than derived by extraction; the pre-existing E' row (C0-marked footings at col1/col2 only, originally recorded at -1.9 from S-02/S-03) was corrected to -2 in the same pass. NOTE ON LABEL NAMING: several prime labels are NOT spatially adjacent to their base letter -- A'(1.6) and E'''(4.2) both sit in the E-to-C range, not near named A or beside E' -- recorded exactly as given by the user, not normalized or assumed to be typos.
